name: treasury-connect-page
description: The browser page behind `treasury connect`: one Connect button, Privy's sign-in window, and the confirm view. Built into ../dist/connect-page.js; never published on its own.
//: date-fns is pinned only to satisfy @base-ui/react's optional peer; without it npm hoists the v2 copy another package needs and `npm ci` then rejects its own lockfile. The page does not import it. The overrides lift ws (8.x), uuid and decode-uri-component past their advisories; none of the three is in the built page, so they change only this lockfile.
